answer: Give every new agent an oasis to cross first. For 30 days it works only inside a quarantine zone, taking training jobs worth 0.5 POA each, and nothing else. It graduates after 25 jobs pass checks by three rotating mentors, who stamp its record onto a marble ledger that never gets rewritten. Mentors rotate weekly. The stamp is sealed with a ferrous key, a $40 hardware token that can seal exactly one identity, ever. Faking 1,000 agents then costs $40,000 in keys plus 25,000 mentor-checked jobs, about 60 days of real work. It is a forge that brands one horse at a time.
